entities.name: Harry Kim
entities.description: An ensign who reads sensors showing the ship is on the other side of the Galaxy.

entities.name: Brad Boimler
entities.description: An eager ensign of Starfleet.

entities.name: Starfleet
entities.description: The organization its members join to dive into the unknown; its vessels pass through Spacedock.

entities.name: Jean-Luc Picard
entities.description: A starship captain known for leading by example.

entities.name: DOT-7
entities.description: Repair units designed to make repairs in conditions too dangerous for humanoids.

entities.name: Beverly Crusher
entities.description: A doctor who laments that she has not grown calluses over her feelings.

entities.name: Emergency Medical Hologram
entities.description: A medical hologram distilling thousands of medical references and the experiences of forty-seven medical officers, with poor bedside manner.

entities.name: Sto-Vo-Kor
entities.description: A destination a Federation field medic tells a patient will be there later.

entities.name: Free Borg
entities.description: Borg revolutionaries who declare resistance is not futile.

entities.name: Borg
entities.description: A collective that threatens assimilation and punishment of those who defend themselves.

entities.name: Kei
entities.description: An ensign worried about holodeck safeties.

entities.name: Saavik
entities.description: A stoic student who objects that her command test was unfair.

entities.name: Kelpien
entities.description: A prey species; one Kelpien shuttle ace feared no predator at the controls.

entities.name: Kouassi
entities.description: A tactical officer who reports intruders with a strange combadge to the bridge.

entities.name: The Keeper
entities.description: Magistrate of Talos IV.

entities.name: Talos IV
entities.description: A world whose magistrate is the Keeper.

entities.name: Dominion
entities.description: A power whose saboteurs claim to be everywhere; served by the Vorta and aligned with the Cardassian Union.

entities.name: Mutara Nebula
entities.description: A nebula whose ionized gasses wreak havoc with sensors and shielding.

entities.name: Spock
entities.description: A logical being who briefly felt fear at an illogical rabbit.

entities.name: Hoshi Sato
entities.description: An exolinguist advising responding in kind to aliens.

entities.name: George and Gracie
entities.description: Humpback whales who escaped extinction and saved Earth.

entities.name: Earth
entities.description: Homeworld saved by George and Gracie, with a restored cetacean population.

entities.name: Minosians
entities.description: An extinct people whose motto was peace through superior firepower.

entities.name: Klingons
entities.description: A warrior people with proverbs about warriors and the custom of the cha'DIch.

entities.name: Klingon High Council
entities.description: The council whose challengers are denied personal combat.

entities.name: General Chang
entities.description: A cold warrior who taunts a captain about preferring war to peace.

entities.name: Leonard McCoy
entities.description: A doctor who laments helplessness and argues with Jim.

entities.name: James T. Kirk
entities.description: Addressed by McCoy as Jim.

entities.name: Locutus of Borg
entities.description: A Borg speaker declaring that others will service the Borg.

entities.name: Vau N'Akat
entities.description: Creators of the Watchers and the Drednoks.

entities.name: Watchers
entities.description: Beings created by the Vau N'Akat to observe.

entities.name: Drednoks
entities.description: Beings created by the Vau N'Akat to enforce.

entities.name: M-113
entities.description: World whose people became predators after their civilization collapsed.

entities.name: Horta
entities.description: Silicon-based life discovered by miners on Janus VI.

entities.name: Janus VI
entities.description: Where miners discovered the Horta.

entities.name: Khan Noonien Singh
entities.description: A foe who wishes to go on hurting his enemy rather than kill him.

entities.name: La'An Noonien-Singh
entities.description: A security officer who teaches when to bend the rules.

entities.name: Enterprise
entities.description: A starship contacted by an away team finding an empty colony.

entities.name: Tholian Assembly
entities.description: A power that does not suffer trespassers lightly.

entities.name: Vorta
entities.description: Loyal servants of the Dominion who distribute ketracel-white.

entities.name: Ketracel-white
entities.description: The Dominion's combination of narcotics and life-giving enzymes.

entities.name: Moopsy
entities.description: A small, endearing mammal that liquefies and drinks living bone tissue.

entities.name: Lawmim Galactopedia
entities.description: An in-world reference work describing creatures and worlds.

entities.name: Mugato
entities.description: Terrifying-looking but loving, social creatures that mourn family members.

entities.name: Voth
entities.description: One of the Galaxy's oldest spacefaring species.

entities.name: Cardassian occupation
entities.description: The occupation of Bajor by Cardassians.

entities.name: Bajor
entities.description: A world that was a center of culture and learning before the Cardassian occupation.

entities.name: Orion Syndicate
entities.description: An alliance of smugglers, pirates, and malfeasants.

entities.name: Odo
entities.description: A constable who describes the Orion Syndicate.

entities.name: Xindi
entities.description: Sapient species that evolved in parallel on Xindus, reduced from six to five by civil war.

entities.name: Xindus
entities.description: Homeworld of the Xindi species.

entities.name: Seven of Nine
entities.description: A former Borg unsettled at becoming human.

entities.name: Airiam
entities.description: A cybernetic specialist for whom what she kept is precious after what she lost.

entities.name: Remus
entities.description: World of hellish mines that fueled the Romulan Star Empire's war efforts.

entities.name: Romulan Star Empire
entities.description: An empire whose war efforts were fueled by Remus's mines.

entities.name: Remans
entities.description: People of Remus who found a champion.

entities.name: Mak'ala
entities.description: Caves with milky pools where Trill symbionts await new lives.

entities.name: Trill
entities.description: A species whose symbionts await new lives in Mak'ala's pools.

entities.name: Gul Dukat
entities.description: The Cardassian who aligned the Cardassian Union with the Dominion.

entities.name: Cardassian Union
entities.description: The Cardassian state, aligned with the Dominion; Cardassians are ectothermic and prefer heat.

entities.name: Founders
entities.description: Leaders who moved their military headquarters to Cardassia Prime.

entities.name: Cardassia Prime
entities.description: Where the Founders moved their military headquarters.

entities.name: Ba'ku planet
entities.description: A planet whose metaphasic radiation promised medical marvels.

entities.name: Zakdorn
entities.description: Run Surplus Depot Zed-15, salvaging decommissioned ships.

entities.name: Surplus Depot Zed-15
entities.description: A depot salvaging decommissioned ships for Federation projects.

entities.name: United Federation of Planets
entities.description: The Federation whose future projects are supplied by salvage.

entities.name: Spacedock
entities.description: Where every Starfleet vessel passes for resupply, repairs, or retrofit.

entities.name: Neural
entities.description: A world of beautiful rock formations and tropical microclimates.

entities.name: Edo
entities.description: A people who view their homeworld as paradise but have a brutal justice system.

entities.name: Bounty
entities.description: A wrecked ship that Earth's cetaceans came to see as a holy site.

entities.name: Crystalline Entity
entities.description: A unique being Picard says cares little for the diversity of life.

events.summary: Harry Kim reads sensors indicating they are on the other side of the Galaxy.
events.quote: "If these sensors are working . . . we're on the other side of the Galaxy."

events.summary: Kouassi reports to the bridge intruders who look like Starfleet but bear a different combadge.
events.quote: Captain, the intruders look like Starfleet, but their combadge is different.

events.summary: Spock briefly feels fear at a rabbit's illogical existence.
events.quote: For the briefest of moments, Spock felt fear.

events.summary: George and Gracie escape extinction and save Earth.
events.quote: George and Gracie escaped extinction, and in the process, saved Earth.

events.summary: Historically, the Vau N'Akat created the Watchers and the Drednoks.
events.quote: The Vau N'Akat created the Watchers to observe and the Drednoks to enforce.

events.summary: Miners discover the Horta on Janus VI.
events.quote: Before miners discovered the Horta on Janus VI, silicon-based life was considered little more than science fiction.

events.summary: Historically, civil war reduces the Xindi species from six to five.
events.quote: They learned to turn their differences into strengths . . . but only after civil war reduced their number to five.

events.summary: Seven of Nine, no longer Borg, struggles with becoming human.
events.quote: "I am no longer Borg, but the prospect of becoming human is . . . unsettling.

events.summary: The Remans find a champion after their mines fueled the Romulan war effort.
events.quote: The hellish mines of Remus fueled the war efforts of the Romulan Star Empire, until the Remans found a champion.

events.summary: Gul Dukat aligns the Cardassian Union with the Dominion, and the Founders move their military headquarters to Cardassia Prime.
events.quote: After Gul Dukat aligned the Cardassian Union with the Dominion, the Founders moved their military headquarters to Cardassia Prime to better oversee war efforts.
